input_fields.name: mismatched_state
input_fields.description: One mismatch with mode explicitly window, document, or script_focus.

input_fields.name: expected_focus_or_document
input_fields.description: Expected target identity for that one mode.

result_fields.name: restored_state
result_fields.description: Mode, target identity, action observation, and final state.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when one-state recovery cannot be safely observed.

procedure: Validate mode and target; reject a request mixing window, document, and script focus.
Perform one mode-specific action: activate target window, activate target document without closing others, or focus script panel.
Re-observe selected state and return restored_state; do not load/run/save as a side effect.
If target cannot be observed or recovery risks user work, return needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject composite recovery, ambiguous targets, and actions closing/overwriting unknown documents.
Reject modal/busy state that prevents safe observation.
Do not claim geometry/script success after focus restoration.
